meta.estrategia_fuente: PDF: official study guide 2025 (Οδηγός Σπουδών, Greek), 'Πίνακας Ι' parsed with pdfplumber tables (code, Greek name, hours, Y/E, ECTS, prerequisites, semester). The guide link is found via the WordPress REST API (page 'Οργάνωση Σπουδών'). Syllabi: ONE shared English PDF 'Courses' Outlines (Engineering)' (official HQA course-outline template per course), linked from the REST page 'Resources for Undergraduates'; page ranges derived from its TOC + 'COURSE CODE' rows.
meta.notas: University of Crete has no Mechanical Engineering degree (that exists at other Greek universities; the Technical University of Crete is a different institution, out of scope). Chosen: first-cycle degree of the Department of Materials Science and Engineering (renamed from 'Materials Science and Technology'; new curriculum ΕΜΥ since 2024-25), UoC's only engineering degree (the other departments of its School of Sciences and Engineering are Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Computer Science, Biology); it includes Mechanics of Materials, Mechanical Design, Transport Phenomena, Fluid Dynamics and a 'Mechanical Engineering and Materials Technology' elective group. 71 rows: 30 compulsory (180 ECTS, 30 per semester 1-6), thesis EMY-440 (12 ECTS, counted as elective), 36 electives (180 ECTS offered; the student takes 60 ECTS of electives incl. the thesis in semesters 7-8), plus 4 rows without outline (sin_guia: PRA-001 Πρακτική Άσκηση Ι (10* ECTS); PRA-002 Πρακτική Άσκηση ΙΙ (10* ECTS); 9I1 Δημοσίευση Ι (5** ECTS); 9I2 Δημοσίευση ΙΙ (5** ECTS)). Offered total 402 vs 240 required. Internships PRA-001/002 give 10 ECTS each but only 5 count towards the degree; 9I1/9I2 'Δημοσίευση' (publication) 5 ECTS each. Elective semesters come from the outline's SEMESTER field (7th/8th). Codes: 'EMY-' + Table I number; Greek letters transliterated (ΠΡΑ->PRA, 9Ι1->9I1). Course names are the English titles of the outlines PDF TOC (Greek names for sin_guia rows).
